( 1． 中南大学湘雅三医院临床药理中心，长沙410013; 2． 中南大学湘雅医学院，长沙410013)YU Jing － jing1 ，KUANG Yun1 ，WANG Hai2 ，YANG Guo － ping1 Abstract: Warfarin is the most common oral anticoagulant for the management of diseases such as atrial fibrillation and deep venous thrombosis. Warfarin has a narrow therapeutic range and dramatic interpatient variability，and may interact with many drugs. Patients with these diseases are usually elderly patients who are prone to infection and have a high frequency of antibiotics use. Adverse events like bleeding resulted from the combination of warfarin and antibiotics have been frequently reported. This review will summarize the progresses on the interactions between warfarin and antibiotics as well as the mechanisms with an attempt to provide a reference for clinical rational drug use and decrease adverse events.( 1． Center of Clinical Pharmacology， The Third Xiangya Hospital of Central South University， Changsha 410013， China; 2． The Xiangya Medical College of Central South University，Changsha 410013，China)华法林是最常用的口服抗凝药物，可有效降低心房颤动，深静脉血栓等患者的血栓栓塞风险，但其治疗窗窄，个体差异大，对于长期服用华法林的患者，需频繁监测其国际标准化比值( INR) ，并调整剂量。 华法林可与多种常用药物发生相互作用，引起抗凝不足或过度抗凝，导致血栓栓塞或出血事件的发生。 在医院，抗菌药物的使用频率较高，且抗菌药物和华法林合用所导致的不良事件也频繁被报道［1 － 2］。 本文对华法林与抗菌药物相互作用及其机制的研究进展作一综述，以期为临床合理用药提供参考，减少不良事件的发生。
